csv_project_name: A/E for Dorbrook Recreation Area and Colts Neck
csv_scope_of_work: The County of Monmouth invites the submission of written proposals from Consultants to provide professional design services for the renovation of Building #2028 at Dorbrook Recreation Area, Colts Neck, NJ. Monmouth County Park System ( MCPS ) intends to convert the structure into a singlestory open-span facility with mezzanine loft to serve as: a. Indoor active recreation space for public use b. Shelter for summer camp and program staff and participants during inclement weather c. Equipment storage for recreation programs d. Restroom facilities. It is the intent of this Request for Proposals to obtain professional design services for the design, permitting, preparation of bid documents, and construction administration for the work shown on the concept drawings developed by the Monmouth County Park System. (See Appendix C ). Based on consultation with MCPS, the Consultant will prepare complete construction plans and technical specifications as required to bid and construct this project. It will be the Consultant s responsibility to familiarize himself/herself with the overall project. The Consultant is responsible for the verification of existing conditions. It is the responsibility of the Consultant to ensure that tasks are completed seamlessly and coherently without gaps. Specifically, the scope of work may require, but is not limited to, the following tasks: ARCHITECTURAL FEASIBILITY STUDY LOFT REMOVAL The Consultant shall review the Owner-provided layout (See Appendix C) and evaluate if converting the barn to a one-story space by removing the loft floor is feasible, considering code compliance without sprinklers. STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING SERVICES LOFT REMOVAL A. Existing Conditions Evaluation and Feasibility Report The Consultant shall: a. Conduct a detailed field investigation of the existing structure. b. Evaluate the structural impact and feasibility of removing the loft floor system and its supporting steel round columns. c. Provide at least two (2) structural design alternatives for supporting the structure while maintaining a clear span for an open indoor recreation area. Provide an alternative analysis discussing construction methods, cost estimates, benefits and challenges of each alternative method. d. Compile findings into a Structural Feasibility Report. This Report must be submitted and reviewed by MCPS prior to the Consultant advancing to subsequent phases of work. MCPS will consider the recommendations of the report, along with anticipated construction costs, to select preferred alternative and overall project feasibility. B. Structural Design If removal of the loft floor is determined to be feasible, the Consultant shall provide design for: a. Safe removal of loft floor framing except in the storage area below the mezzanine, where the existing loft floor and posts shall remain. b. Removal of interior steel columns supporting the loft except those within the storage area. c. Structural member modifications (if required) d. Additional structural members (if required) e. New concrete slab-on-grade system suitable for recreation use f. Provide structural design and framing for a new mezzanine system to support proposed storage space. g. Provide structural design for a new stair system and associated framing to access the mezzanine. ARCHITECTURAL SERVICES (If Loft Removal Is Feasible) The Consultant shall provide complete architectural design services, including: A. Existing Conditions Verification a. Verify existing floor plans, ceiling heights, exterior envelope, doors, windows, and accessibility conditions. b. Incorporate surveyed field conditions into the construction documents. B. Interior Renovations as shown on drawings (not limited to) a. Demolition of existing horse stalls b. Interior aesthetic upgrades consistent with MCPS standards c. Patch and refinish wood walls d. Repair and refinish existing doors with new hardware e. Restore windows to operational condition f. Install shatter-resistant safety film on glazing g. Create a partition and mezzanine to provide new storage space. Existing posts and loft floor within the storage area shall remain. h. Replace the fixed ladder with an OSHA-compliant pull-down insulated stair i. Design a prefabricated stairway to access the Mezzanine (as an alternate). C. Floor System a. Regrading and preparation of subgrade b. Installation of new concrete slab with slip-resistant sealed finish suitable for recreation use c. Exterior linear drainage at doors D. Interior Design services are not required in this project. MECHANICAL, ELECTRICAL & PLUMBING SERVICES The Consultant shall field-verify existing mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems and document existing conditions affecting the new design. A. Mechanical: The building currently has no active mechanical systems. The Consultant shall: a. Provide heating and cooling systems and ventilation, including exhaust fan(s) ducted to the exterior, for the proposed restroom areas in compliance with all applicable codes. b. Evaluate and design appropriate ventilation for the main barn space to ensure adequate air movement and indoor air quality suitable for assembly and recreational use. c. Provide equipment schedules, load calculations, and all associated ductwork, controls, and appurtenances required for a complete and functional system. d. Ensure compliance with all applicable mechanical and energy codes. B. Electrical: The building currently has no active electrical service. The Consultant shall: a. Coordinate new electrical service with Jersey Central Power & Light. b. Demolish existing electrical components. c. Replace electrical panels. d. Remove existing Light fixtures and provide a new lighting system suitable for recreation use. e. Provide emergency lighting and illuminated exit signage. f. Provide two ceiling fans for the proposed multipurpose area. g. Provide general-purpose receptacles. h. Provide exterior lighting as required. i. Ensure compliance with all applicable electrical codes. C. Plumbing: The building currently has no active water service. The Consultant shall: a. Coordinate new water service connection. b. Demolish existing plumbing systems. c. Provide restroom ventilation systems. d. Provide complete plumbing design, including: o Proposed unisex bathroom(s) (Proposed Quantity can be reduced if permitted by code) o Domestic water supply o Sanitary waste o Vent piping o Mop sink o Drinking fountain CIVIL ENGINEERING & SITE WORK The Consultant shall review existing grades, drainage patterns, paving, and site utilities surrounding the barn and document conditions affecting accessibility, stormwater management, and building performance. The Consultant shall provide civil engineering design for the following: A. Utility Connections a. Electrical service coordination b. Water service connection c. Septic connection - The Consultant shall design the connection of the Festoon Barn sanitary system to the existing septic system servicing the adjacent Activity Center. B. Drainage Improvements a. Gravel perimeter drainage system b. Perforated piping within gravel trench c. Positive drainage away from the structure d. Integration with existing stormwater system e. Exterior linear drainage at doors f. Bathroom drainage as required C. Accessible Site Improvements a. Concrete sidewalk from courtyard patio to main entrance b. Concrete sidewalk from accessible parking space to entrance c. ADA-compliant slopes and transitions d. Signage and wayfinding improvements
